fields.description:
## Context / Problem

Five recurrences of one defect class: rebar's prompted structured-output extraction is
schema-blind — `tolerant_parse` (src/rebar/llm/structured.py:121) returns the FIRST parseable
JSON object in a reply (fenced blocks first, `_FENCE_RE` at :40, then `_first_json_object` at
:82), so any JSON-shaped material the model quotes (tool results, dependency-link records,
examples) beats the real payload appearing later. Latest instance: bug child "Completion
verifier returns a dependency-link record instead of a CompletionVerdict" blocked a legitimate
close. Prior instance-fixes (git 9007f290, 5ed760a1, 1aa90fa5) keep being re-broken by routine
model swaps (the Bedrock cutover changed the trigger rate). This epic retires the class, not
the instance. All design decisions were derisked by live experiments E1–E4 recorded as
comments on the bug child (design-investigation + experiment-results comments).

## Approach

Three coordinated thrusts, each child independently landable via Gerrit, fail-closed
throughout:

1. **Harden the prompted path every model shares**: schema-filtered candidate selection with
   last-valid-wins in `parse_structured` (the bug child); an explicit sentinel output channel
   whose directive and extraction land atomically (sentinel child); an opt-in replayable
   raw-reply artifact on parse failure (artifact child).
2. **Provider-native structured output where MEASURED safe**: raise the Bedrock SDK floor
   (SDK child); replace `output_mode()`'s stale blanket thinking guard with measured
   call-property gating (guard child); add exact-id measured-fact capability rows only for
   cells a live measurement passed (rows child). Unmeasured cells stay prompted.
3. **Measure, don't assume**: a reusable provider-matrix raw-output baseline/eval harness
   running as a manual CI job where the API keys already live (harness child).

## Acceptance Criteria

Each criterion is delivered by exactly one child, with no overlapping responsibilities.

- [x] A reply that quotes schema-valid-looking JSON before the real payload parses to the
      correct contract object — delivered by the selection bug child; checked by its corpus +
      property tests passing under `make test`.
- [x] Prompted structured replies carry an explicit sentinel output channel whose extraction
      ships in the same change as the directive — sentinel child; checked by its unit pins and
      recorded before/after eval artifact.
- [x] A final structured-parse failure can leave an opt-in replayable raw-reply artifact,
      default off — artifact child; checked by its config-effect contrast tests.
- [x] The locked Bedrock SDK accepts Converse `outputConfig` client-side (botocore >= 1.43) —
      SDK child; checked by lock resolution and a recorded `uv tree` version proof.
- [x] `output_mode` gates native output on measured thinking-compatibility per model instead
      of blanket-forcing prompted — guard child; checked by its contrast unit tests.
- [x] Every model cell measured PASS runs native structured output and every unmeasured or
      failing cell stays prompted with a recorded reason — rows child; checked by
      config-effect tests through the real capability read path plus the recorded cell table.
- [x] Before/after raw-output distributions for the configured provider matrix exist as
      recorded, deterministically scored artifacts — harness child; checked by the
      workflow_dispatch run's uploaded artifacts referenced on that child.

## Risks

- Trailing-recap schema-valid decoy wins under last-valid-wins — accepted residual; a warning
  marks it; zero of the five historical recurrences show that layout (E3 evidence).
- The sentinel directive changes output distribution (measured: quote-in-prose 0% -> 100%) —
  mitigated by shipping directive+extraction atomically and measuring before/after (harness).
- Bedrock rejects `outputConfig` for opus-4-7/4-8 server-side — those cells stay on the
  hardened prompted path with a recorded re-measure trigger; no workaround exists client-side.
- The botocore floor collides with the `[eval]` -> aiobotocore cap — pyproject.toml's
  `[tool.uv]` conflicts block (~line 261) already forks eval vs bedrock resolution; the SDK
  child must keep those forks resolvable.
